sentences.en: A man who is absorbed in his work looks animated.
sentences.zh: 一个全神贯注于工作的男人看起来很有活力。

sentences.en: He will have gotten the inspiration from that animated cartoon.
sentences.zh: 他从那部动画片中获得了灵感。

sentences.en: What was your favourite animated film when you were younger?
sentences.zh: 你小时候最喜欢哪一部动画电影？

senses.zh: 活的：有活力的：life; 使有活力，支持：high-spirited energy; 使行动，驱使：action; 使活灵活现，使栩栩如生：lifelike movement

mnemonic: 词根记忆：anim（生命，精神）+ate（使…）→使有生命→赋予生命
